text:
nora-cs: quick recap from onboarding call: NimbusTide wants dedicated capacity. Cutover window target is next Tue 09:00 UTC. We need final quota numbers, autoscale policy, a smoke/dry-run plan, and a fallback routing rule. who can pick this up?

devin-infra: I can take provisioning + quota assignment. pls confirm expected steady/peak and avg tokens. also need to know if they require a dedicated VPC IP range.

nora-cs: They gave a traffic profile: steady ~800 rps, nightly batch spikes to ~2800 rps lasting 3-4m, avg tokens ~420, ~5% of requests are embeddings.

sam-sre: autoscale proposal: min_replicas=3, max_replicas=16; scale out +2 replicas when GPU_util > 70% for 40s; scale in -1 after 120s cool-down. Add latency circuit: if p95 > 1.5s for 2 continuous minutes trigger safe-fallback. Also require KV-cache pre-warm step.

rekha-cs: I'll own customer smoke and quality checks. Plan to run a shadow dry-run 72h before cutover and a public dry-run 24h prior. Will prepare an eval set (30 prompts) for regression detection.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-8012 NimbusTide dedicated bring-up  owners: devin-infra, sam-sre, rekha-cs  dry-run scheduled: 2024-11-14T02:00:00Z.

devin-infra: terraform snippet for quota (posting here for visibility):
```
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "nimbus_tide" {
  name       = "nimbus-tide-pool"
  region     = "us-west-2"
  min_nodes  = 3
  max_nodes  = 16
  gpu_type   = "g5x.4"
  quota_tokens_per_min = 200000
}
```

nora-cs: Fallback plan idea: non-essential analytics route -> hosted small-variant; critical chat route -> throttle to 60% of baseline and surface degraded flag to customer. This keeps API stable during saturation.

sam-sre: load test plan (phased):
- phase A: prefix warm & KV validation (10m) at 300rps
- phase B: sustained soak (45m) at 800rps with eval runs every 5m
- phase C: burst ramps: 3x spikes to 3k rps with 2m holds
I will run tests from our CI runner using vegeta. command:
```
echo "GET https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -duration=45m -rate=800 | tee results.bin | vegeta report
```

rekha-cs: I'll attach the quality harness and expected baseline metrics to CS-8012. We'll flag any response drift >5% in semantic-similarity score as a blocker.

drew-cto: two quick asks: 1) does this change renewal terms? 2) confirm KMS/HSM integration will be ready.

nora-cs: renewal: we'll flag as at-risk if customer experiences >1% error rate or >30% SLA misses for 72h post-cutover. KMS: devin, can you confirm HSM key binding timeline?

devin-infra: HSM/KMS binding is in progress; expecting completion EOD two days before cutover. I'll post the KMS checklist link in the ticket.

sam-sre: owners + timeline: devin = infra/provisioning & KMS, sam = load tests + autoscale tuning, rekha = evals & smoke runs, nora = customer comms & go/no-go. dry-run (shadow) 2024-11-12 02:00Z; final dry-run 2024-11-14 02:00Z.

nora-cs: Great. Action items: devin post terraform & KMS checklist, sam push vegeta scripts to CS-8012, rekha share eval harness, I'll prepare go/no-go checklist and inform customer of windows. ping me immediately on any blocker. :rocket:
